description: A skipped final file can cause inference on an empty image batch.
trigger: Run the new CLI with only an unreadable/non-image file, or with a skipped final file immediately after a completed batch.
expected_behavior: Count the skipped file and finish without invoking inference on an empty batch.
actual_behavior: The end-of-input condition invokes get_image_embeddings even when batch_images is empty. Gemma3 reaches torch.cat with an empty tensor list. Mistral3 returns an empty list, after which Tokenizer.encode reaches max([]). The source therefore exposes a failure path instead of printing final totals normally. Parent-tree search found no imgsearch callers; the established entry point is the new script's __main__ invocation.

verification.description: Transcribed the batch accumulation and flush condition. Both an all-skipped singleton and a valid image followed by a skipped file produced an empty final call.
verification.limits: No image decoding, tensor library or repository function executed.

introductions.rationale: New imgsearch.py batching caller introduced at250; parent has no imgsearch caller.
